title: Dog script
script: local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character  local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera  local hum=c.Humanoid  local animation=Instance.new("Animation") animation.AnimationId="rbxassetid://180436334" local track=hum:LoadAnimation(animation) track:Play(1,5,1)  local hrp=c.HumanoidRootPart  local cfr=hrp.CFrame while c.Parent==workspace do     local delta=task.wait()     cfr=cfr+hum.MoveDirection*delta*20     if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude~=0 then         cfr=cfr:Lerp(CFrame.new(cfr.Position,cfr.Position+hum.MoveDirection),math.clamp(delta*10,0,1))                  hrp.CFrame=cfr*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75),0,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)         track:AdjustSpeed(1)     else         hrp.CFrame=cfr*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-50),0,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-2.5)         track:AdjustSpeed(0.01)     end     hrp.Velocity=Vector3.zero     hrp.RotVelocity=Vector3.zero end

comments.text: It's good for roleplaying but only r6 work
